description: Submission of Recommendations of the Finance Commission to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the provisions of Article 154 of the Constitution, the Finance Commission has been entrusted with the responsibility of recommending the resource requirement for the Provincial Councils established in terms of the 13th Amendment to the Constitution and the principles to be followed in allocating the grants allocated to the Provincial Councils from the National Budget to each Provincial Council. Accordingly, the Finance Commission has submitted its recommendations to the Hon. President on the manner in which the Capital Grants should be allocated to the Provincial Councils from the 2026 National Budget and on the manner in which the Recurrent Expenditure should be set off.  The proposal made by the Hon. President to implement the said recommendations and to submit the same to Parliament in accordance with the provisions of Article 154R(7) of the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.
